hey, thinking about picking the game up for long term, how is the f2p experience and what is the endgame generally like? does it get very difficult or its manageable even with non meta teams? also seen/read that its still being actively translated, does that only affect the story or are there items too still being translated?

very good game for f2p, generous with pulls, but it does require dupes for characters to be viable endgame

Endgame is difficult, this is one of the most skill testing gacha games, u will need to optimize and pull specific meta characters if u want to improve your chances. All characters can clear though, its just a question of how much struggle/required investment u can tolerate
the main story is fully translated but some side stories and out of the way sections are still MTL

The game is very f2p friendly with pulls. The bottleneck in this game are resources to level up all the characters.
The endgame is pretty hard, but pretty much all characters can clear it (same as other gachas to be fair). The difference here is that it's easier to get dupes of the characters to vertically invest in them, compared to some other gachas. You'll need 19 character minimum for endgame, so you'll have to pull for different characters anyway and try different teams out.
